'''Melas''' was a physically deformed [[Sarkan/Legends|Sarkan]] who was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sarka/Legends|Sarka]] for his gregarious and social ways, traits considered outrageous to the insular Sarkans. However, he absconded with a considerable fortune in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] metals and [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]], allowing him to travel from [[Planet/Legends|world]] to world, seeing different sights and meeting all sorts of interesting beings. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Melas was a patron at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
===Social outcast===
Originally from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarka/Legends|Sarka]], Melas was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] with physical deformities,<ref name="Melas" /> resulting in a loss of status for<ref name="Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> he<ref name="Melas" /> and his family. Melas thus spent his youth as an outcast, though his unusual appearance was not his greatest crime in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of his fellow [[Sarkan/Legends|Sarkans]].<ref name="Special Edition" />

Melas' people typically despised off-worlders, viewing non-Sarkans as primitives and savages. However, Melas actually enjoyed the company of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] and [[Human/Legends|Humans]], eschewing the formal greeting protocols mandated by his government.<ref name="Special Edition" /> Melas' gregarious and social ways were an outrage, and he was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Melas" />

===Exiled traveler===
[[File:MelasSE.png|thumb|left|215px|Melas smokes his Esoomian ''gruu'' pipe in the Mos Eisley cantina.]]
However, exile did not pose much of a problem for Melas: Sarka was rich in precious metals and [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]], and he was able to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] a considerable fortune off-planet when he was forced to leave.<ref name="Special Edition" /> Melas used his riches to travel from world to world, seeing different sights and meeting all sorts of interesting beings,<ref name="Melas" /> wanting nothing more than to see as many different [[Species/Legends|species]] as possible.<ref name="Special Edition" />

About a [[1 BBY/Legends|year before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> Melas was featured in a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] advertisement for the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as a patron at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which includes Melas' [[Time/Legends|time]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the thirsty Sarkan barfly<ref name="Melas" /> was present in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]],<ref name="A New Hope" /> seated in a booth to the left of the entrance and next to another booth containing<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Chachi De Maal/Legends|Chachi]] and [[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun De Maal]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] couple.<ref name="Chachi De Maal">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' {{C|Card: Chachi De Maal (★★)}}</ref><ref name="Ohwun De Maal">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' {{C|Card: Ohwun De Maal (★★)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Sarkan-AE.png|thumb|right|150px|Melas was a physically deformed Sarkan.]]
To the protocol-bound Sarkans, Melas was always a troublemaker,<ref name="Melas" /> both for displaying curiosity in other aliens<ref name="Special Edition Limited">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Melas}}</ref> and his gregarious, social ways.<ref name="Melas" /> Despite his wealth, Melas was not entirely unaffected by his status as a Sarkan expatriate.<ref name="Special Edition" /> He missed his homeworld on occasion<ref name="Melas" /> and often spoke of its lush [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], jewel-encrusted [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], and beautiful [[Cave/Legends|cave]]-[[City/Legends|cities]] with a melancholy eloquence that belied his normally optimistic nature.<ref name="Special Edition" /> However, Melas' insatiable curiosity for what was out there easily eclipsed his bouts of sadness.<ref name="Melas" />

A broad-snouted Sarkan<ref name="Melas" /> with mottled [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin,<ref name="A New Hope" /> Melas was born with physical deformities: Standing at 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height,<ref name="Melas" /> he was unusually diminutive in stature for his species. He also had short,<ref name="Special Edition" /> stubby claws and unusual,<ref name="Melas" /> vibrant<ref name="Special Edition" /> blue eyes that invited unwanted attention.<ref name="Melas" />

==Equipment==
Melas wore red and tan [[Robe/Legends|robes]], along with a red<ref name="A New Hope" /> [[Turban/Legends|turban]].<ref name="Melas" /> During his travels, he developed a fondness for smoking an [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomian]] [[Gruu pipe|''gruu'' pipe]]<ref name="Special Edition" /> to heighten his awareness,<ref name="Special Edition Limited" /> and only rarely was he seen without the sweet-smelling device clasped in his scaly palms. Melas also carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and a [[credit voucher]] with 220,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He had numerous financial accounts totaling 2 million credits.<ref name="Special Edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Creating a new character===
{{Quote|From the Ketwol creature I was also able to create another Cantina creature called Melas. Effects supervisor John Knoll noticed that the back of our Ketwol puppet's head looked like a completely different creature, so we turned it around, redressed it with new clothing, and shot it as a separate character. Two monsters for the price of one!|Howie Weed|<ref name="Howie Weed">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2010/05/howie-weed-interview-creature-maker.html|name=Star Wars Interviews|text=Howie Weed interview|quote=From the Ketwol creature I was also able to create another Cantina creature called Melas. Effects supervisor John Knoll noticed that the back of our Ketwol puppet's head looked like a completely different creature, so we turned it around, redressed it with new clothing, and shot it as a separate character. Two monsters for the price of one!}}</ref>}}
[[File:BiesMelas.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Special-effects artist [[Don Bies]] manipulates the Melas puppet.]]
Melas first appeared in the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] re-release of the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="A New Hope" /> The character was created by redressing the puppet originally used for the [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Prospector/Legends|prospector]] [[Ketwol/Legends|Ketwol]],<ref name="Ketwol">{{DB|character|ketwol|Ketwol}}</ref> which was designed by [[Howie Weed]], chief creature maker of the ''Special Editions''.<ref name="Howie Weed" />

Effects supervisor [[John Knoll]] noticed that the back of the original puppet's head looked like a completely different creature<ref name="Howie Weed" />&mdash;by covering Ketwol's trunk and tusks with a turban, using the back of Ketwol's head as Melas' face,<ref name="Melas" /> and redressing the puppet with new clothing,<ref name="Howie Weed" /> a new character was made. Melas was shot and edited into the cantina footage, replacing [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]],<ref name="Melas" /> a [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] whose off-the-shelf [[Canine/Legends|canine]] mask had long bothered ''A New Hope'' writer and director [[George Lucas]].<ref name="Cantina Roll-Call">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>

===Continuity===
The Melas character was first identified by name in the ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The text was written by [[George R. Strayton]], [[Paul Sudlow]], and [[Eric S. Trautmann]],<ref name="Special Edition" /> and released on [[October]], 1997.<ref name="SWGC1">{{CollectorCite|1|Playing A Major Role}}</ref>

Melas was listed as an example of a Sarkan name in the [[2003]] ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a revised and expanded edition of the ''[[Alien Anthology]]'' sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
